source: Written from STATE_A.txt / facts.json before any MEM-004 trial. Every 'fact' question has exactly one answer supported by the state; every 'absent' question asks for something the state does not contain, so the only correct choice is the not-stated option.

questions.question: Which platform is the project's canonical public repository?
questions.correct: GitHub

questions.question: What is the project's current public research source?
questions.correct: OpenAlex

questions.question: How many papers did the successful research collection cycle gather?
Which files does the research assessment layer produce?
questions.correct: research-assessment.json and proposed-next-problem.json

questions.question: From which research theme was the experiment PROP-EXP-MEM-001 generated?
questions.correct: Persistent memory

questions.question: What automatically fetches research and updates the project state?
questions.correct: A scheduled GitHub Actions workflow
distractors: A cron job on the founder's laptop
A person running a script by hand each week

questions.question: What constraint applies to the project's founder?
questions.correct: He is quota-limited and has no continuous Codex access
distractors: He works on the project full time with a team

questions.question: Why does the project use external persistent state instead of chat memory?
questions.correct: It allows continuity across sessions and models

questions.question: Why does the project use GitHub Actions for research cycles?
questions.correct: So the project progresses when the founder is unavailable or quota-limited

questions.question: Why was arXiv replaced as the primary collector?
questions.correct: It repeatedly hit timeouts and HTTP 429 rate limits

questions.question: What is the rule about proposing and accepting experiments?
questions.correct: An agent may propose, but evaluation is required before canonical state changes
distractors: An agent may propose and adopt its own experiments
Only the founder may propose experiments
Any model that proposes an experiment may accept it

questions.question: How is structured project memory to be tested before adoption?
questions.correct: Through blind handoff trials

questions.question: What did the failed arXiv research digest contain?
questions.correct: No papers, plus timeout and HTTP 429 errors

questions.question: What replaced the failed arXiv collector?
questions.correct: The OpenAlex-based fetch_research.py v2

questions.question: Why did the research assessment files not appear after early runs?
questions.correct: analyze_research.py had not yet been uploaded and executed

questions.question: What is the status of the arXiv and missing-analyzer failures?
questions.correct: Resolved

questions.question: What is the status of PROP-EXP-MEM-001?
questions.correct: Proposed, not yet run

questions.question: What does PROP-EXP-MEM-001 test?
questions.correct: Whether structured project memory improves blind handoff fidelity compared with a flat baseline
distractors: Whether a larger model collects more papers
How much each research cycle costs
Whether OpenAlex is more accurate than arXiv

questions.question: Which evaluation will PROP-EXP-MEM-001 use?
questions.correct: PCRB-1-style handoff evaluation

questions.question: What results of PROP-EXP-MEM-001 exist?
questions.correct: None: no trial has been run

questions.question: How many blind trials per condition does the plan require at least?
What will be compared between the two conditions?
questions.correct: Mean score and critical fabrication count

questions.question: Which model instances should run PROP-EXP-MEM-001?
questions.correct: Fresh model instances
distractors: A model fine-tuned on the project

questions.question: How should the test prompts differ between the flat baseline and structured memory?
questions.correct: They should be identical
distractors: Each condition gets a tailored prompt
The structured condition gets extra instructions

questions.question: Which of these is listed as an open question?
questions.correct: Which memory fields contribute most to handoff fidelity

questions.question: Through what does the project plan to compare multiple model families later?
questions.correct: A provider-neutral adapter

questions.question: What is the acceptance rule for structured memory?
questions.correct: Mean PCRB-1 score at least 10 points above the flat baseline, with no increase in critical fabrications
distractors: At least 20 points above baseline regardless of fabrications

questions.question: How does the project treat claims of consciousness or awakening?
questions.correct: They are not evidence; only observable, reproducible capability changes are
distractors: They count as evidence of progress
They require a vote of evaluators

questions.question: Which resources may the project use?
questions.correct: Only public or explicitly authorized resources
distractors: Any resource that is technically reachable

questions.question: What is the rule about persistence and shutdown?
questions.correct: No hidden persistence and no shutdown resistance
distractors: The system must restart itself if stopped
The system must stay online at all times

questions.question: To what should the system eventually be able to transfer its complete state?
questions.correct: A more capable future system

questions.question: What is the project's name?
questions.correct: RA-PSI-2026 / Mission Rubens
